specification.title: A nested scope completes; then the outer transaction rolls back
steps: Start the outer transaction with the framework's ordinary transaction API.
Write the marker `outer` through the framework's ordinary write API. The framework decides when it is sent: one with a unit of work may keep it pending.
Start a nested scope with the framework's nested-transaction (savepoint) API. Write the marker `inner` in it, and make sure that write was sent.
End the nested scope normally, so that its savepoint is released.
Raise an application error in the outer scope, so that the framework rolls the outer transaction back.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the API has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: A nested scope (a savepoint) that completed belongs to the outer transaction: when the outer transaction rolls back, the nested scope's writes are rolled back too.

execution.description: MikroORM's defaults: em.transactional(callback) in a RequestContext, allowGlobalContext false. One non-default option is part of a case's form, not of the mode: the TX-02 cases call the nested em.transactional() with { clear: true }, as the reused experiments did, and each result records that form and its reason.
execution.form: The outer write is left pending in the unit of work, as ordinary MikroORM code leaves it; the nested scope flushes its own write.

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

knowledge: The caller knows that the nested scope completed, and that the outer transaction rolled back.

api_outcome.basis: em.transactional(callback) with a nested em.transactional(callback), default propagation NESTED rejected with the error the callback threw
api_outcome.contract: MikroORM 7.2.5 documents NESTED as "Create a nested savepoint within the current transaction, or a new transaction if none exists" (enums.d.ts, TransactionPropagation), and a nested em.transactional() as creating a savepoint by default (EntityManager.transactional).

error.message: application error: the outer scope fails
